remote.getInstances.description: Lists the other Cuebot computers set up on the Remote page, and the ones connected to you, with their status.
remote.getInstances.returns: A list. Each item has name, outgoing (true when you connect to it), state (like "Connected"), message, instanceId, instanceName, instanceOs, instanceVersion and connectedAt.

remote.sendSignal.description: Sends a named signal to another Cuebot computer, so an action there can react to it. Fails when the name is empty.

parameters.name: The signal name, like "sceneChanged".
parameters.instance: Optional. Which computer to send to (its name or id). Leave it out for every connected one.
parameters.args: Optional. Extra values to send along, as an object, like { "scene": "Gameplay" }.

remote.sendSignal.returns: How many computers got the signal (0 when none are connected).

remote.waitForSignal.description: Waits until another Cuebot computer sends a signal with this name. Only signals that arrive after you start waiting count.

parameters.name: The signal name to wait for, like "ready".
parameters.instance: Optional. Only accept it from this computer (its name or id). Leave it out for any computer.
parameters.timeoutMs: Optional. How long to wait, in milliseconds. Leave it out for 30000 (30 seconds); 0 waits forever.

remote.waitForSignal.returns: The signal with name, sender (the action that sent it), instanceId, instanceName, instanceLabel, instanceOs, instanceVersion and args. null when time ran out.
